resources.title: A Poem for Every Day of the Year
resources.author: Allie Esiri
resources.rationale: While students enjoy more historical poetry in these grades, this delightful anthology adds variety and spice to their diets to make sure they don't forget to simply enjoy the sights and sounds of words and the curious ways poets can communicate silly and serious truths. Poems from across the centuries are featured and come with a short introductory note to whet students' appetites.

resources.title: A Poem to Read Aloud Every Day of the Year
resources.author: Liz Ison

resources.title: African American Poetry: 250 Years of Struggle & Song
resources.author: Kevin Young

resources.title: Beautiful Stories from Shakespeare
resources.author: Edith Nesbit
resources.rationale: Retellings of plays that can be used as a teacher resource or read to students who are new to Shakespeare.

resources.title: Great Stage of Fools: A Guide to Six Shakespeare Plays
resources.author: Peter Leithart
resources.rationale: Teacher resource that provides analysis and background information for the three plays scheduled this year.

resources.title: I, Too, Sing America: Three Centuries of African American Poetry
resources.author: Catherine Clinton
resources.rationale: This is a collection of poems from 25 African American poets across three centuries. Meaningful illustrations and brief biographies bring context to the poems.

resources.title: Metaphors We Live By
resources.author: George Lakoff & Mark Johnson
resources.rationale: Classic text discussing metaphors which embed ourselves into everyday language and shape the way we think and see the world.

resources.title: Stories from Shakespeare
resources.author: Marchette Chute
resources.rationale: A highly recommended "retelling" book that offers the plot, some quotes, and a bit of explanation. A perfect teacher resource to read before starting the play.

resources.title: Tales from Shakespeare
resources.author: Charles and Mary Lamb
resources.rationale: An introduction to the study of Shakespeare.

resources.title: The Making of a Poem
resources.author: Eavan Boland, Mark Strand
resources.rationale: Students read this anthology to learn how to study the characteristics and history of various poetic forms and then enjoy a number of examples from poets across the years, including many from this year's time period.

resources.title: This Day: Collected and New Sabbath Poems
resources.author: Wendell Berry
